Build strength, improve mobility, and leave your whole body feeling more connected in just 12 minutes. This no-equipment yoga workout challenges your balance, stability, and control while helping you move with greater ease. The way you move under light challenge shapes how you respond to bigger ones, both on and off the mat.
Practice with us consistently inside The Wolfpack Path. A guided, self-paced practice with structure, intention, community, and no interruptions:
Breathe and Flow offers a functional, yoga-inspired approach to movement and conscious living.
